answer.reason: The six keys of STAGE_BY_STATE are exactly the six JobState values of wordmarket-sdk, and the core looks them up directly from the raw vendor text (STAGE_BY_STATE[s.stateCode]), so the key set is the vendor's own vocabulary in the application core. The domain's vocabulary is the coarser set of stage values (claimed and drafting both map to IN_TRANSLATION), and that translation belongs in an adapte
